title: Reportification, Artifact Underdelivery, and Execution Claims under Meta-Task Instructions: A Black-Box Study of Multimodal LLMs
description:
Exploratory technical report. We separate model behavior into three independent dimensions — artifact delivery, report-artifact relation, and execution-claim veracity — and annotate 35 samples black-box. In these 35 samples: under-delivery 42.9%, report substitution 20.0%, false completion claims 17.1%, concretized descriptions of unexecuted work 17.1%.

The preregistered image primary analysis was not executed due to a delivery floor effect; the exploratory text control found no reduction in delivery (+0.4, p=1.00), and the sample is insufficient to establish equivalence.

This report does not claim a new failure mechanism, nor a demonstrable increment over existing taxonomies. It provides a reproducible annotation framework, traceable cases, and hypotheses for further testing. Known limits: image content annotation not performed; no systematic literature review.
